rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". Right now I'm in an early phase of figuring out where Halcyon Threshold can be most useful. A few things on my mind: 1. Research: Understanding what's actually neglected in the AI safety/governance landscape. There are a lot of organizations doing good work, but I want to find gaps rather than duplicate effort. 2. Resource compilation: Making it easier for newcomers to understand the landscape and find ways to contribute. 3. Eventually, possibly small grants or evaluations — but that's further out. Would any of those interest you? Even just helping me think through priorities would be valuable. Happy to hop on a call if that's easier. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman (volunteer)**: Responded warmly, invited her to help with research and thinking through priorities.
